n.exclusions: Post-exclusion sample: initial 497 reduced to 377 after validation checks; exclusions include low English proficiency, low seriousness, prior exposure, incomplete responses, failed attention checks, and <5 seconds on decision-style scale or a scenario question (main p.24; supplementary pp.33,47). Problems 6 and 7 were assigned to separate randomized subsets.
